Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Soccer injury. Anterior knee pain.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal. 
Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss at the posterior lateral tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: Markedly thickened with intense edema and interstitial tearing proximally. No full-thickness tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 4 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Severe patellar tendinosis with proximal partial thickness interstitial tearing.
2.	Low-grade lateral compartment chondrosis.

COMPARISON:Plain films [Date].

CLINICAL HISTORY:Left knee pain, clinical suspicion for structural damage.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The lateral meniscus is intact. Intrasubstance degeneration within the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, without discrete tear. There is slight peripheral extrusion of the lateral meniscal body, without evidence of discrete tear.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments, as well as iliotibial band are intact.

Quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 4 mm, within normal limits. Minimal prepatellar superficial soft tissue edema.

There is fissuring of articular cartilage throughout the patellofemoral compartment most pronounced at the patellar apex and extending along the medial patellar facet, as well as the medial femoral trochlea. Preserved medial and lateral femorotibial articular coverage.

Trace knee joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. Small Baker's cyst. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. No evidence of discrete meniscal, ligament, or tendon tear.
2. Mild to moderate patellofemoral chondrosis, suggesting patellofemoral osteoarthritis. Preserved medial and lateral femorotibial imaged.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Rodilla izquierda traumática.
Hallazgos:
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal con su sin signos de rotura.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco medial que impresiona
contactar la superficie articular inferior 9 periférica a nivel del cuerpo, sugiriendo una rotura, no
desplazada
Úlcera condral de espesor total de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial que mide
aproximadamente 4 x 5 mm en sus ejes mayores, con cambios óseos secundarios. Úlceras
condrales de espesor parcial de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial.
El resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales
de espesor parcial y prácticamente total de distribución difusa de la rótula.
Leve derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos. Laminar cantidad de líquido de los
componentes de la musculatura poplítea, inespecífico.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital y de la inserción proximal del
tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Probable rotura periférica del menisco medial, correlacionar con clínica.
Condropatía focal grado 4 de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial. Condropatía con
lesiones grado 2 y 3 en la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 y 3 de la rótula de distribución difusa.
Leve derrame articular.
Tendinosis rotuliana proximal y cuadricipital distal

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafifçe artmış. Patellofemoral dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal>lateral kondral dejenerasyon ve medyalde tam kata yakın fisür ile karakterize. Kemikler ve diğer kıkırdaklar (hafif dejenerasyon dışında) normal. Çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzundaki kompleks yırtık her iki eklem yüzüne de ulaşıyor. Posteromedyal parakapsüler ödem hafif dereceli ve eklem kapsülünde yırtık lehine sıvı interpozisyonu yok. Posterolateral köşe yapıları korunmuş. Semimembranozus tendonozisi hafif dereceli. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve retinakulumlar normal).

Regelrechte Artikulationsverhältnisse im linken Knie. Kein Knochenmarködem bei insgesamt unauffälligem Knochenmarkssignal. Kein Nachweis einer Fraktur. Patellofemoral unauffälliger Knorpelüberzug ohne Nachweis einer Chondropathie. Patella zentriert stehend. Auch am  femorotibialen Kompartiment regelrechter Knorpelüberzug. Menisci morphologisch unauffällig mit signalarmer Signalgebung. Kollateralbänder intakt. Kein Gelenkerguss. Umgebende Muskulatur und Subkutis unauffällig.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain; anterior and lateral knee pain for 4 days after fall during skiing, with clicking, locking, and buckling 
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla extremity system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Anterior translation of the tibia in reference to the femur. Osseous contusions along the lateral femoral condyle terminal sulcus, posterior lateral tibial plateau and peripheral medial femoral condyle. No acute fracture. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate hemarthrosis. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Complete tear of the proximal to midsubstance ACL. 
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Grade 1 MCL sprain. 
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Grade 1 sprain of the fibular collateral ligament. 
Posterolateral corner structures: As above.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 17 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
Grade 1 strain of the proximal popliteus muscle. No muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. Edema along the posterolateral subcutaneous tissues.

IMPRESSION:
Findings compatible with acute pivot shift injury, including:
    -Complete tear of the proximal to midsubstance ACL.
    -Osseous contusions along the lateral femoral condyle terminal sulcus, posterior lateral tibial plateau, and peripheral medial tibial plateau.
    -Grade 1 MCL sprain.
    -Grade 1 fibular collateral ligament sprain. Grade 1 strain of the popliteus muscle.
    -Moderate hemarthrosis.

Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalaze se uznapredovale OA promjene medijalnog
kompartmenta femorotibijalnog zgloba s denudacijom artikulacijskih hrskavica i zonama
subhondralnog edema zglobnih tijela.
Vidi se radijalna ruptura kroz stražnji rog medijalnog meniska uz stražnji korijen, a kroz dio
prednjeg roga, trup i ostatak stražnjeg roga pruža se horizontalna ruptura - opisano vj. na
degenerativnoj podlozi uz ekstruziju meniska.
Povišen je intenzitet signala prednjeg roga i trupa lateralnog meniska u smislu uznapredovalih
degenerativnih promjena, uz moguću parcijalnu vertikalnu rupturu donje plohe trupa.
Distenzija MCL. LCL održan uz entezopatske promjene hvatišta za femur.
Degenerativne promjene ACL blažeg stupnja, uz održan kontinuitet. PCL primjerenog prikaza.
Patela je medioponirana, Wiberg 1, uz reduciranu debljinu artikulacijske hrskavice
femoropatelarnog zgloba i hondromalaciju II. stupnja. Osteofiti kranijalnog i kaudalnog pola
patele.
Hondromalacija II./III. stupnja lateralnog kompartmenta femorotibijalnog zgloba.
Entezopatske promjene hvatišta m. kvadricepsa.
Parcijalna ruptura mišićno-tetivnog prijelaza m. popliteusa.
Parcijalna ruptura m. semimembranosus na hvatištu za tibiju.
Masna atrofija prikazane natkoljenične muskulature GC 2.
Izljev u koljenu. Bakerova cista, aksijalno dimenzija 23 x 9 mm.
Supkutani edem prepatelarno i infrapatelarno.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain
Comparison: Radiograph [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Abnormal linear hyperintense signal in the body and posterior horn of the meniscus extending obliquely to the tibial articular surface with additional vertical components along the undersurface of the posterior horn there is a small displaced oblique fragment along the free edge of the body/posterior horn (series 7001, image 9 and series 6001, images 6 and 7).
Medial compartment cartilage: Mild loss of cartilage along the medial femoral condyle with minimal subchondral marrow edema. 

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full thickness loss of cartilage at the junction of the medial and lateral patellar facets and partial-thickness loss of cartilage along the medial portion of the lateral patellar facet with small foci of subchondral marrow edema. There is moderate loss of cartilage in the central/medial femoral trochlea. Small marginal osteophytes are noted in the patellofemoral joint compartment.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Imaged tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Complex tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
2. Moderate patellofemoral osteoarthritis and mild medial compartment osteoarthritis.
3. Small knee joint effusion.

In der externen MR-VU von 01/24 nur unvollständig erfasste popcornartige T2w überwiegend hyperintense Läsion im distalen Femurschaft mit einer Ausdehnung von 27 x 16 x 17 mm (7/15 sowie 9/24), in erster Linie passend zu einem Enchondrom. Kein Scalloping. Ansonsten unauffällige Signalgebung der ossären Strukturen in den vorliegenden Sequenzen, kein Knochenmarksödem, kein bone bruise Areal. Keine wesentliche Chondropathie. Bei anamnestisch Läsion des Innenmeniskus diskrete mukoide Signalalterationen im Hinterhorn ohne wertbaren Befundwandel zur VU (exemplarisch 8/8), keine neue Rissbildung. Der Außenmeniskus ohne Anhalt für eine Rissbildung. VKB und HKB intakt. MCL und LCL intakt. Geringer medialer Reizzustand. Akzentuierte Gelenkflüssigkeit. Quadriceps- sowie Patellarsehne mit intakter Signalgebung. Die miterfassten Weichteile in den vorliegenden Sequenzen mit unauffälliger Signalgebung.

Findings: No evidence of knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is mild thinning of the medial compartment articular cartilage but no underlying bony change. The lateral compartment articular cartilage is well preserved. Mild patellofemoral articular cartilage thinning is also seen. Normal visualized bones and surrounding soft tissues.  
Conclusion: Mild degenerate changes as described.
